algorithm_groups.experimental_scope: Historical LiDAR/IMU simulation baseline, not the new joint estimator.
Native 19-dimensional state; fixed-map/independent-native-observation approximation is retained.
Core mathematical checks plus actual native-state replay. Full single recorded flight: 37 applied native mean/covariance changes; this is not a multiseed or AP-flight result.

Original 83.753s flight; common 24144 sensor inputs, 127 source seed opportunities, 123 completed pairs. No nearest-range restamping or truth input. Single flight does not prove statistical superiority.
Synthetic scalar/rate moments and Monte Carlo coverage; point estimates identical across uncertainty assumptions; not raw-image state fusion.
Declared Gaussian mechanism with independent audit; not a live state estimator or sensor calibration.
19+1+6 linear fixture and primitive-latent oracle; distinct from the nonlinear 19+6+3 production extension.
Deterministic SO(3)/gyro fixtures and earlier recorded frontend preconditions. Earlier zero-update scope is retained.
Rendered image frontend plus protocol/PTY software tooling; no selected real camera or optical-flow hardware validation.
Captured-example metadata failures do not simulate physical low texture, full sensor failure, or fused-error performance.
B1 input acquisition and range-noise verification; latest B1 AP failure is not erased by replay. Range reference is evaluator-only.
Historical FAST-LIO task layer; engineered inflation is not calibrated for the new joint estimator.
Train-only empirical factors on old estimator/domain; not distribution-free, arbitrary-direction, or trajectory-wide guarantees.
Sampled point-map hard feasibility; not continuous swept volume or guaranteed physical braking.
Heuristic surfel forecast/discrete surrogate search; does not propagate full joint state-map correlations or prove global optimality.
Old independent simulation results and historical online-map comparisons; not jointly revalidated with raw-flow estimator.
Contains both legacy Python proxy kernels and actual vendored ROS EGO packages; these must not be conflated.
Historical dynamic-obstacle simulation; commanded intervention is not instantaneous actuator stopping.
Historical online task tests plus fault-tool availability; no assertion that all those cases were rerun on the new joint estimator.
Offline time studies and AP4.7.1 disarmed communication probes are separate evidence. No new joint estimator armed mission or hardware claim.
Six profiles times five selection seeds were index-only dry-run validated. No production multi-method degradation matrix was run; same-flight phase seeds are not independent flight trials.

portability_findings.detail: Primary research workspace has 44 missing canonical files plus 4 changed files. Stage canonical source, not the stale research src/scripts/config.
Historical shell runners hardcode research workspace and preservation/asset paths; retain for provenance, use reviewed portable launchers rather than silently rewriting protected source.

Historical replay/study tools include original canonical/archive/AP locations and some bound SHA identities; require explicit frozen-input export and a launcher/path adapter, or mark unavailable. Do not substitute current algorithms into historical results.
Frozen reference index points to original absolute DB paths. Prepare a new index for bundled raw bag; keep original acquisition/payload/source SHA identities and independent truth exports.
gpu_lidar and cameras require a render backend even with gz sim -s; EGL/Mesa llvmpipe is an existing software path, not GPU-free sensor physics or a measured server throughput guarantee.
15 ROS packages declare Apache2, BSD, GPL2 or GPL3. Preserve upstream LICENSE/PROVENANCE and notices; no single Apache license represents the whole bundle.
Range/camera/LiDAR selection profiles exist and source transforms were validated; no full multiseed degradation estimator matrix or real low-texture/nonflat-plane experiment is available.

Historical P6-P15 planning/task math is included but not jointly recalibrated/revalidated with new clone-plane-flow state. AP4.7.1 disarmed probes do not establish an armed mission with the joint estimator.

scope: Read-only static file/algorithm coverage audit. Historical absolute paths still require declared launch adapters; PASS is not proof that every entrypoint runs. GPU sensor rendering, dependencies and runtime remain separate gates.
